text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is right around the 
corner. 
While coordinating the details of the 
Shuntaisai Training Camp with Azuma-san...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
---Trainer. 
What are your plans regarding the course 
of instruction?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As summer marks the midpoint of the year, 
reconsidering 
one's direction and setting a fresh path 
is truly most opportune.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
If you please, perhaps you might reflect 
once more 
upon the training policy 
together with Lady <chrname>?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...May this summer prove 
a fruitful harvest for you all.

She makes a great point. It would be wise 
to review 
which ritual teachings we want to master 
before camp begins.

I immediately called <chrname> over 
to reassess our strategy.
